name: Hector Sosa
office: City of Downey, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Hector Sosa is the District 2 representative on the Downey City Council. Elected in 2022, he has also served as mayor. He works in financial services and holds a business degree from Cal State Los Angeles. He has volunteered with Gangs Out of Downey, West Downey Little League, and the Downey Junior Athletic Association. His campaign says his priorities include public safety, fiscal responsibility, and supporting small businesses. His campaign says he voted against City Council pay increases and opposed term limit extensions. It also states that as Budget Subcommittee chair, he helped the city deliver its 14th consecutive balanced budget. He proposed a tiered fee structure for conditional use permits, which the Council unanimously approved.
